 Order

Learned Senior counsel for the petitioners submits that the land of the petitioners, which was initially subject of acquisition proceedings and the final award dated 02.11.2007 also passed, has not been acquired nor the compensation disbursed to the petitioners.

Therefore, the said land of the petitioner, therefore, deserves to be de-notified from the acquisition proceedings/final award passed by the respondents by invoking the provisions of Section 93 of the Act in vogue, i.e., Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as the "Act").

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the respondents has produced a copy of the Communication dated 06.06.2024 issued by the Collector Land Acquisition, Rajouri, perusal whereof reveals that the Intending Department could not take over the possession of the acquired land for the reason that the Executive Officer, Municipal Committee, Thannamandi vide Communication dated 25.07.2013 addressed to the Director Urban Local Bodies, Jammu requested for de-notification of awarded land and to identify new alternate land for construction of Bus Stand, Thannamandi.

Pursuant thereto,
the Director, Urban Local Bodies, Jammu vide Communication dated 19.10.2013 requested to de- notify the acquired land intended for the construction of bus stand and alternate land be provided for the said purpose by way of acquisition and, accordingly, placed Indent for fresh acquisition of land.

The Collector Land Acquisition, Thanamandi thereafter issued fresh notification dated 08.12.2018 for land measuring 25 Kanals & 13 Marlas comprising Khasra Nos. 261, 262, 263 and 264 situated at Village Thannamandi, Tehsil Thannamandi.
The said communication dated 06.06.2024 is taken on record.

sentences.text: In the aforesaid development, learned Senior counsel for the petitioner fairly submits that his case falls within the ambit of the Section 24 (2) of the Act, as the proceedings have since lapsed and also in light of the fact that the land has been de-notified and the acquisition proceedings issued initially have been withdrawn.
The land of the petitioners, as such, is free from all encumbrances and is required to be used by the petitioners.

4. Heard learned Senior counsel for the petitioners and perused the record.
5.
Prima-facie case for interim indulgence is made out.
6. Issue notice.
7. Ms. Aparna Gupta, Assisting counsel to Mrs. Monika Kohli, Sr. AAG on behalf of respondents.

8. List again on 26.07.2024.
9.
Meanwhile, subject to objections from the other side and till next date of hearing, status-quo with respect to the aforesaid land, which is owned and possessed by the petitioners shall be maintained.
10. Alteration/modification/vacation on motion.
(Wasim Sadiq Nargal) Judge JAMMU 07.06.2024
